slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-174 leftAttachment
scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 DXF source with a root-reachable STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE record. It contains one group-174 INTEGER leftAttachment value 0 and an opaque group-302 tag. The selected transaction changes only leftAttachment from 0 to 7; all other encoded style values remain unchanged.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table identifies code 174 as Text Left Attachment Type
fieldEvidence.valueDomainSource: Autodesk AutoCAD ActiveX API history reference lists AcTextAttachmentType values 0 through 8
fieldEvidence.classification: Authoritative Autodesk DXF field-role and ActiveX enum-domain corroboration plus authored adapter transaction evidence; not independent producer or native rendering acceptance

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain exactly one existing group-174 INTEGER corresponding to parsed leftAttachment. The target value must be within the documented enum range 0..8. leftAttachment must be the only changed typed payload field; identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-174 value in a copy of the captured raw body. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 174, conflicting raw changes, simultaneous edits, out-of-range enum values, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: Inspect staged OBJECTS output against retained raw fields and mapped handles, then decode the emitted MLEADERSTYLE and require leftAttachment to equal 7 while maxLeaderPoints remains 0. Fresh readback checks typed value and exactly one literal group-174 INTEGER value 7. Both source encodings are exercised, with same-format output and ASCII/binary cross-format output.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing captured raw group 174 from 0 to 1 while typed leftAttachment requests 7 refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. Value 9 and simultaneous maxLeaderPoints edits also refuse atomically. A late typed mutation after preflight refuses without replacing the destination; restoring the requested value permits same-adapter retry. Exact output and fresh-readback checks pass after retry.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep existing raw replay. Transactions are not admitted for other source or target versions or multiple changes on one record. DWG-origin writing is unchanged. Test sources and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture is committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits group 174=0 in the STANDARD source; ASCII and binary source files are generated locally from scratch at test runtime.

focusedBuild.toolchain: Configured build-gcc; CMake 4.4.4, Unix Makefiles, Apple Clang 21.0.0 via /usr/bin/g++, -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror

focusedSelectors.summary: 2/2 passed. The authored group-174 profile proves exact output/readback for ASCII and binary sources, same-format and cross-format output, raw conflict rollback, invalid enum refusal, simultaneous-field refusal, late-mutation rollback and corrected same-adapter retry.

limitations: Evidence qualifies one authored AC1027 left-attachment transaction only. It does not prove independent producer variation, native annotation placement/rendering, cross-version support, DWG editing, consumer acceptance or complete document closure.
The support ledger remains closed; no format support claim is promoted.
